title: LUT based SynRM Control Reference
text: Generate lookup-table-based control reference currents for field-oriented control of SynRM and PMaSynRM, 3 inputs, 2 outputs, {Motor parameter input method} sets Type of motor; {Motor topology} sets the synchronous reluctance motor topology Synchronous reluctance, {Definition of d-axis and q-axis} sets the alignment of d - and q -axes Ld > Lq, {Number of pole pairs}, {Stator resistance per phase, Rs (Ohm)} sets the resistance of stator phase winding, {Vdc input method} sets the input method for Vdc Specify, {DC voltage to compute LUTs (V)} sets the dC bus voltage, {DC voltage breakpoint vector, VdcVec (V)} sets the dC bus voltage lookup, {Enable percentages for torque breakpoint vector} enables percentage values for torque breakpoint, {Enable custom breakpoint vectors for torque and speed} uses custom breakpoints for torque, {Reference percentage torque breakpoint vector, Trefpct (%)} sets the torque reference lookup, {Torque envelope for speed breakpoint vector, wrpm (rpm)} sets the torque envelope values for speed breakpoint, {Reference torque breakpoint vector, Tref (Nm)} sets the torque reference lookup, {Mechanical speed breakpoint vector, wrpm (rpm)} sets the rotor speed lookup, {Current Limit, I_limit (A)} sets the maximum phase current limit for motor, {Viscous damping coefficient, Bv (Nm-s/rad)} sets the viscous damping coefficient 1e-6, {D-axis current breakpoint vector, id (A)} sets the d-axis current lookup, {Q-axis current breakpoint vector, iq (A)} sets the q-axis current lookup, {Use measured (instead of computed) torque} uses measured value of torque, {Measured torque LUT, T(id,iq) (Nm)} sets the measured lookup data, {Stator d-axis inductance, Ld (H)} sets the d-axis stator winding, {Stator q-axis inductance, Lq (H)} sets the q-axis stator winding, {Permanent magnet flux linkage (Wb)} sets the permanent magnet flux, {D-axis flux linkage LUT, FluxD (id,iq) (Wb)} sets the reference d-axis flux linkage lookup data, {Q-axis flux linkage LUT, FluxQ (id,iq) (Wb)} sets the reference q-axis flux linkage lookup data, {Ld LUT, Ld(id,iq) (H)} sets the d-axis inductance lookup data 0.9e-3 *, {Lq LUT, Lq(id,iq) (H)} sets the q-axis inductance lookup data 0.15e-3 *, {PM flux linkage LUT, FluxPM(id,iq) (Wb)} sets the permanent magnet flux linkage lookup data 0.4e-4 *, {Reference id LUT, id(Tref,wrpm) (A)} sets the reference d-axis current lookup data, {Reference id LUT, id(Tref,wrpm,Vdc) (A)} sets the reference d-axis current lookup data cat, {Reference iq LUT, iq(Tref,wrpm) (A)} sets the reference q-axis current lookup data, {Reference iq LUT, iq(Tref,wrpm,Vdc) (A)} sets the reference q-axis current lookup data, {Input units} sets the unit of measure of block input values, {Base voltage (V)} sets the nominal voltage limit 24/sqrt, {Base current (A)} sets the nominal current limit, {Base speed (rpm)} sets the nominal speed limit, {Base torque (Nm)} sets the nominal torque limit, {Allow scaled-down motor parameters with CodeGen (higher precision with Fixed-Point data type)} scales down internal parameters to match per-unit, {Enable saving the computed LUTs} enables block to save computed LUTs, {Compute (and plot) id and iq LUTs}, {Use default options for plotting} uses default options to plot constraint, {Motor speed (RPM)} sets the motor speed for plotting constraint curves, {Motor torque (Nm)} sets the motor torque for plotting constraint, {Enable plotting the drive characteristics} enables block to plot drive characteristics, {Include the drive characteristics for an increased motor current} enables block to plot drive characteristics for an increased motor, {Plot constraint curves} and {Compute and show}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Motor topology
params.values: Synchronous reluctance motor topology Synchronous reluctance motor (default) | PM-assisted synchronous reluctance motor

params.name: Definition of d-axis and q-axis
params.values: Alignment of d - and q -axes Ld > Lq (different from PMSM) (default) | Lq > Ld (same as PMSM)

params.name: Number of pole pairs
params.values: Number of pole pairs available in motor 4 (default) | scalar

params.name: Stator resistance per phase, Rs (Ohm)
params.values: Resistance of stator phase winding (ohms) 0.8 (default) | scalar

params.name: Vdc input method
params.values: Input method for Vdc Specify via dialog (default) | Input port - use 3D LUT (voltage slice based) | Input port - use 2D LUT (scaled-w based)

params.name: DC voltage to compute LUTs (V)
params.values: DC bus voltage (volts) 24 (default) | scalar

params.name: DC voltage breakpoint vector, VdcVec (V)
params.values: DC bus voltage lookup vector (volts) [18,30] (default) | vector

params.name: Motor parameter input method
params.values: Type of motor parameters Linear model with lumped parameters (default) | Non-linear model with D,Q-flux linkage LUTs | Non-linear model with Ld and Lq LUTs | Non-linear model with Ld, Lq, and FluxPM LUTs | Non-linear model with id and iq LUTs
